about: --report notes each undeclared package that looks published: a pyproject.toml with [build-system], a package.json with a name and no private: true, a Cargo.toml with a lib target and no publish = false. Not noted: a pyproject.toml with no build system, a private package.json, publish = false, a bin-only crate, a package declared under library. Manifests ship as .fixture so an adopter's dependency bots never read them.
